name: The super editions mod
author: Davibuster7
description: Foil Packs, three Foil-themed Jokers, Foil Stake, Foil Deck, Foil Pack Tag, and Shield summon tag. Ruggiero: one Legendary with editionless, Foil, Holographic and Polychrome abilities. Normal, Jumbo and Mega Polychrome Packs with guaranteed Polychrome Jokers. Polychrome Jokers: Pollinator, Poli-faker and Forest protector. Polychrome Pack Tag, Polychromic Tag and post-Gold Polychrome Stake with an edition-blocking sticker. Polychrome Deck: no starting Kings, Polychrome Jokers and playing cards with ordinary edition Mult; choose 0-10 Exoplanets at run start and forfeit that many completed-Blind cashouts; consumables excluded. Polychrome consumables: Future-ness, Showmanry and Exoplanet. Triple Tag and optional Chat Plays compatibility. Normal Holographic Pack with ordinary Joker rarity selection. Edition packs give matching themed Jokers 3x selection weight within their normal rarity pools. The phone: Rare Holographic-themed Joker, 1 in 10 chance to add Holographic to each editionless scoring card before the hand scores. Scalper: Rare manual shop Joker; triple-click to buy a $5 enhanced/sealed Holographic face card or sell selected editioned face cards for $3 each. 1 of 1: Rare Joker, scored Holographic face cards gain Eternal and a random seal (only Blue seals replaced); gains $20 sell value per qualifying card, without retrigger gains. Holographic Stake follows Polychrome: skipping replaces the current Blind with a Boss Blind and grants two copies of its tag. Both stakes inherit the vanilla chain without Foil Stake. Mega Holographic Pack and Holographic Pack Tag. Holographic Joker Tag grants a free Joker, waits for room and has a 5% Legendary roll including eligible Ruggiero. Ethereal Tag weight 3, Joker Tag weight 5. Holographic Ruggiero gives X10 Mult each time a Holographic playing card scores. Holographic Deck starts with 52 Holographic playing cards and awards a free Mega Holographic Pack per defeated Boss Blind, opening after the shop. Adds Jumbo Holographic Pack and separate Jumbo/Mega Holographic artwork: reversed waves and a central vortex. Adds Tarnished Spectral (destroy enhanced/editioned cards in hand for $100; requires at least one destructible enhanced or editioned card) and The Shark Tarot (destroy one selected editioned playing card for three Negative Immolates), with dedicated artwork. Adds Blue Jupiter, leveling the new Polychrome Flush House (300 Chips / 20 Mult, +50 / +5 per level). Polychrome Ruggiero now requires that hand: Mult^5 with fewer than five owned Jokers, otherwise Mult^2, first after card scoring. Adds Negative Pack: four Negative Joker offers, choose one for $4; weight 0.06 and a 1% eligible Ruggiero roll per offer. Inverted Buffoon-inspired artwork. Existing edition deck restrictions and sticker priority apply. Negative Ruggiero: once per acquired copy, owned Jokers use zero net slots without changing editions; when acquired alone, grants this to the next five acquired Jokers. Benefits require the granting copy to remain owned, Negative and active. Adds Investor: Rare $8 Joker, +1 card selection for play/discard per owned active copy. Adds Two Triplets and Flush 6 (six matching rank and suit), with larger-hand validation and simplified approved artwork. Adds Factorial: Epic $12 Negative-themed Joker. Straights multiply Mult by the factorial of their lowest rank; Ace is 14 with King in that Straight, otherwise 1. Negative Packs favor Factorial with 3x within-rarity weight. Adds Gum: Rare $8, editionless Joker that attaches at shop exit, follows its host on the right and grants +1 permanent ability retrigger. Gum disappears after five completed rounds; the upgrade stays. Adds Infinity: Epic $12, visible ten-round countdown, next scoring hand at zero receives X1.7e308 Mult, then countdown resets to ten. Description is only the infinity symbol. Adds Martyr: Epic $12, click to link one Joker or three while Negative. Selling linked Jokers activates her; sell Martyr to restore all sold links with their saved state, even beyond the Joker limit. Adds The Treasure: Epic $12, pays $10 per round from a saved $100 reserve and destroys itself after its tenth payout. Adds Mayor: Rare $12, copies the compatible Joker to its left and repeats that copied ability once when it awards XMult during scoring. Adds Negative Stake above Holographic: subtracts one from starting hands, discards, hand size, play/discard selection limits, cash, Joker slots and consumable slots. Inherits Holographic, Polychrome and vanilla stakes without Foil. Negative Sticker: 10% on shop/pack Jokers, adds one slot cost; Negative editions still save one and active Negative Ruggiero can make linked Jokers free. Epic rarity has base weight 0.01. Factorial no longer clamps high-rank factorial results. Adds Flipside: Epic $16; each scoring playing-card activation, including retriggers, has a 1-in-20 chance to become Negative. Successful conversions permanently block duplication while allowing retriggers. Blueprint and Brainstorm cannot copy Flipside. Existing edition rules remain in force. Adds Negative Pack Tag (free normal Negative Pack) and immediate Ruggiero Tag: permanently upgrades future edition-pack Joker offers to a 10% Legendary chance, half favoring eligible Ruggiero. Applies to shop and tag packs, not direct Joker tags. Adds dedicated Foil, Polychrome, Holographic and Negative stake selection artwork. Existing stake gameplay is unchanged. Adds configurable Speedy Scoring, seed visibility controls and a Deck stats tab in Run Info. Adds experimental extended scores up to about 2e1000 on LuaJIT, Infinity display and invalid-score recovery; native verification pending. Adds Negative Deck, Paralellize Spectral, Parallel Universe Money Tarot, Solar System Planet and Common free Dollar Bill Joker. Adds Sparta!!!!!!!, Philosophy, Stop Sign, Trash Can and Arcade Machine, with saved state and draft artwork. Native verification remains pending. Adds Jumbo Negative Pack: five Joker offers, choose one, $8, 2% eligible Ruggiero chance per offer. Remakes Stop Sign artwork. Adds Mega Negative Pack and whole-played-row Negative Flipside mode. Fixes startup when the optional Card.start_drag method is absent. Fixes autosaving extended scores after Infinity activates. Fixes input locking while Holographic Joker Tag waits to deliver its reward. Repairs Foil Stake scoring, guarantees shop-bought Stop Sign is Eternal before emplacement, fits Polychrome Sticker to the card, and dispatches Holographic Stake immediate tag rewards before the converted Boss. Fixes Foilmaker and Factorial scoring after Steamodded clears its loading reference. Ensures Foilmaker final-score boosts survive the score animation and count toward defeating the Blind. Adds Inflation challenge: Ante 39, Eternal Burglar and editionless Ruggiero plus ten Eternal Negative Blueprints, money locked at $0, win after the Ante 39 Boss. Inflation now starts with 156 Lucky playing cards: 78 Spades and 78 Hearts, six copies of each rank in each suit. Editionless Ruggiero can be copied when fewer than 20 hands remain in the round; copied scoring does not duplicate his score-bank growth. Adds Stamp of Approval: Epic $12; Joker retriggers refresh a Red Seal for an extra repeat, up to three times per source Joker per card per hand. Adds Jack of red trades: Rare $8, starts with one stored Red Seal, gains one every two rounds (limit one), and applies it to the first retriggering card with one immediate extra repeat. Two sprites indicate its stored seal. Adds Roulette: a rare Spectral with one hidden 50% roll to give every played card a Red Seal over the next five hands, including unscored cards and replacing existing seals. Negative Deck starts with ordinary cards, has a 20% chance to make the whole final played hand Negative at each Blind end, 3X Blind sizes, 10X Negative weight for Joker editions and 10X Negative Pack weight, with ordinary overall Joker edition chance. Both decks have custom back artwork. Foil Deck starts with $1 extra. Holographic Deck adds X1.1 Mult to each Holographic edition activation, alongside the normal bonus. Both decks now use their approved custom spiral backs. Adds Weeping Deck: Purple Seal discards retain their normal reward and store an extra Tarot. Double-click the counter to create stored random Tarots beyond consumable capacity; duplicate Tarots are allowed. Adds Warrior Deck, alternating Warrior/Flowing after completed rounds. Warrior awards Orange to the card crossing 100,000 projected hand score; Flowing gives Orange to unsealed cards drawn in the shop and shop packs. Orange seals grant random vanilla seals to unsealed adjacent played cards when scoring.
